personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical, and highly responsive command-center for competitive sports trivia, driven by live metrics and energetic accents.

spacing.rule: Use tight, intentional spacing. No oversized padding. Maintain strict structural alignment for rapid scanning.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation.
Use tinted brand backgrounds for active states instead of blur.
dont's: No blur or frosted glass. Clarity and performance beat aesthetics for this utility personality.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: High-impact entry point featuring Google Sign-In.

states.loading: Dark spinner over the stadium hero background.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image (`login_hero`) with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top 0% to bottom 90% surface inverse logic, wait, background is dark so transparent to surface). Text sits in the bottom 30%. Large display typography for 'TRIVIA BLITZ'. A wide, pill-shaped Google Sign-In button using surfaceInverse.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center to view current rank and select a sports category.

states.error: Failed to load categories error message with Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Top section: Profile summary (Avatar, Total Score, Global Rank). Below: 'Select Sport' section using a 2-column grid. Cards are sharp (radius md), surfaceSecondary with a brandTertiary tinted icon container. Tapping a card opens a sharp bottom sheet to select Difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard) as segmented controls, and a 'Start Match' CTA pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Quiz Gameplay
screens.purpose: Immersive, distraction-free trivia match with live countdown.
screens.layout: Top header: 'Quit' button left, 'Score: XX' right. Below header: Large circular timer (using brandPrimary, turning error red at <5s) with huge Barlow Condensed countdown inside. Middle: Question text in IBM Plex Sans (xl, weight 500). Bottom: 4 answer buttons stacked vertically. Buttons are surfaceSecondary with a 0.5pt border. On select, border highlights. Correct answer flips to success background/border, wrong flips to error. Bottom-most edge: persistent progress bar.

screens.name: Results Summary
screens.purpose: Post-match breakdown of performance and score calculation.
screens.layout: Top: 'Match Over' large display text. Middle: Stat grid (Accuracy, Time Bonus, Total Points) using stacked metrics (Barlow Condensed numbers, small IBM Plex Sans labels). Bottom: Two side-by-side buttons: 'Play Again' (brandPrimary) and 'Leaderboard' (surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Global Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Ranked view of top players and the user's relative position.

states.empty: No rankings available yet - be the first!

screens.layout: Top section: Blurred podium image background with gradient scrim. Displays Top 3 users in staggered vertical blocks. Below: Scrollable ranked list. Rows are surfaceSecondary, sharp edges, with Rank #, Avatar, Name, and Score. The current user's rank is pinned as a sticky row at the bottom.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User's historical performance, stats, and settings.

states.empty: Play a match to see your stats.

screens.layout: Cover image (`profile_cover`) with gradient scrim. Avatar overlaps the bottom edge of the cover. Below: 'Career Stats' grid (Total Matches, Win Rate, Best Category). Bottom: Settings list rows (Sound, Haptics, Logout).

login_hero.alt: Dramatic stadium spotlight beam in black and white

profile_cover.alt: Black running track with white lines

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 7 Dark-First Utility personality: prefer sharp corners (sm/md radius), solid dark surfaces (surfaceSecondary), and zero blur/glassmorphism.

Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to surface color) over all full-bleed backgrounds like the Login Hero and Profile Cover, ensuring the bottom stop is >= 70% opacity for text readability.

Typography: Use Barlow Condensed (weight 500) strictly for numeric metrics, scores, countdown timers, and major display headers. Use IBM Plex Sans (weight 400/500) for all other UI text, questions, and buttons.

For the Trivia Gameplay screen, the 4 answer buttons must have defined active states: default (surfaceSecondary + border), correct (success border + onSuccess text), wrong (error border + onError text).
On the Home Dashboard, use a 2-column grid for the sports categories. Each card must have a tinted icon container (brandTertiary bg with brandPrimary icon) - do not use raw icons.
In the Leaderboard, the current user's rank MUST be a sticky row at the bottom of the screen, sitting above the bottom tab bar.
Integrate the 'haptics' block accurately during interactions, especially the timer tick for the last 5 seconds and answer selections.
Never use blue/indigo/purple colors as per the prompt rules; rely entirely on the provided Ember/Signal Red accent against the Obsidian dark palette.
